candidates.description: This feature vector is sensitive to the Thai consonant 'ล' (lo ling) and common Thai syllable blocks containing it.
This vector represents Thai consonant characters and subword tokens containing the Thai letter "น" (no).
This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant 'ส' (so suea) across various vowel combinations, tones, and contexts.
This vector activates in response to sequential three-digit numbers, particularly in the 190s and 200s.
This vector activates on two-digit numerical values, predominantly representing ages, scores, or measurements in the sixties, seventies, and eighties.
This feature vector represents common Thai words, morphs, and subword tokens.
This vector represents diverse, non-English character sequences, punctuation marks, and subword tokens that frequently appear in multilingual or foreign-language text encodings.
This feature vector activates on fragments of Thai script, mixed Latin abbreviations, and common formatting artifacts.
This feature vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual characters, numbers, and symbols that lack a cohesive semantic theme.
This vector represents numerical values, specifically hundreds and smaller quantities.
